content.text:
The series **converges**. I ran the query on Wolfram|Alpha, and it returned a closed form for the sum (an alternate form written with the digamma/polygamma function and the Euler–Mascheroni constant γ). The page text I could read did not include the numeric value.

The convergence follows from comparison. For every n ≥ 1, 0 < 1/(n³+1) < 1/n³. The p-series Σ 1/n³ has p = 3 > 1, so it converges, and the smaller series does too.

The sum is approximately 0.6865, which is the standard value and not something I read off the page.
